next.reason: 1985: identifier-1 may be in any Data Division section; a Report Section item must be PAGE-COUNTER, LINE-COUNTER or a sum counter of the report containing the SOURCE clause. §2023:13.18.53.3 SR4: 'If identifier-1 specifies a report section item, it shall be a report counter identifier or a sum counter defined in the current report.'; §2023:8.4.3.15.3 SR1: 'In the report section, PAGE-COUNTER and LINE-COUNTER may be referenced only in a SOURCE clause.' Same operands accepted and refused at compile time; the arithmetic-expression operand is new syntax. The report counter format states no part of this rule, so it is not in 'to'.
